tutorials.name: Steady hover
tutorials.description: Find hover throttle and stay inside a target without drifting.

steps.text: Use Angle mode for this exercise. Throttle controls lift; small roll and pitch corrections stop drift.
steps.title: Understand lift and Angle mode

steps.text: Take off and hold inside the marker for four seconds. Stay below 1 m/s; passing through it quickly does not count.
steps.title: Hold a steady hover

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land at the start

tutorials.name: Climb and descend
tutorials.description: Change height without turning a gentle descent into a fall.

steps.text: Start in Angle mode. Add a little throttle to climb; reduce it slightly to descend. Keep room to stop.
steps.title: Plan a controlled climb

steps.text: Hold the lower marker with gentle corrections.
steps.title: Settle at the lower marker

steps.text: Climb to the upper marker. Reduce throttle early enough to stop the climb.
steps.title: Climb and stop

steps.text: Descend to the lower marker. Add throttle before reaching it to slow the descent.
steps.title: Descend and stop

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land at the start

tutorials.name: Turn without drifting
tutorials.description: Rotate the nose while keeping a steady position and height.

steps.text: Use Angle mode. Yaw turns the nose. After a turn, pitch and roll follow the new direction; the controls have not reversed.
steps.title: Understand yaw and orientation

steps.text: Hover in the marker and face the original takeoff direction.
steps.title: Face the takeoff direction

steps.text: Yaw right by a quarter turn while staying inside the marker. Release yaw when facing the new direction.
steps.title: Turn right without drifting

steps.text: Yaw back to the original direction and stop drifting.
steps.title: Turn back and settle

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land at the start

tutorials.name: Brake and land precisely
tutorials.description: Move to a nearby target, brake before it and return to a marked landing.

steps.text: Use Angle mode. To stop forward travel, briefly tilt back, then level out. Releasing pitch alone does not stop momentum.
steps.title: Understand momentum and braking

steps.text: Take off and settle inside the start marker.
steps.title: Settle at the start

steps.text: Move to the next marker and brake before reaching it. Hold below 0.8 m/s for three seconds.
steps.title: Move forward and brake

steps.text: Return to the start marker and stop before descending.
steps.title: Return and stop

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land on the marker

tutorials.name: Plan a wide turn
tutorials.description: Look ahead, leave clearance and link three original Hangar gates.

steps.text: Follow the original Hangar gates. Before a corner, reduce speed and look toward the next opening. Bank with roll and guide the nose with yaw.
steps.title: Plan the corner

steps.text: Fly through gate 1. Approach its centre with room to turn afterwards.
steps.title: Approach gate 1

steps.text: Turn toward gate 2. Use a gentle bank; avoid sliding into the outside wall.
steps.title: Bank toward gate 2

steps.text: Link the turn into gate 3. Follow the next-gate marker instead of staring at the gate behind you.
steps.title: Link the turn into gate 3

steps.text: Choose an open floor area, level out and land gently.
steps.title: Land in an open area

tutorials.name: Fly through narrow gates
tutorials.description: Control speed and height through the original Minus Two practice gates.

steps.text: These gates are much lower and narrower. Approach slowly, centre the opening and make small corrections. Throttle adjusts height.
steps.title: Prepare a slow approach

steps.text: Pass gate 1 without touching the frame. Slow down before the opening.
steps.title: Centre gate 1

steps.text: Pass gate 2. Keep the horizon steady and avoid a last-second throttle jump.
steps.title: Hold height through gate 2

steps.text: Pass gate 3. Prepare the approach early and keep space from the ceiling.
steps.title: Prepare gate 3 early

steps.text: Stop in a clear area and hold a gentle landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Stop and land

tutorials.name: First steps in Acro
tutorials.description: Learn that releasing the stick stops rotation, rather than automatically levelling the drone.

steps.text: Switch to Acro with M or your mapped flight-mode control. Use small taps: centre sticks stop rotation, but you must level the drone yourself.
steps.title: Understand Acro mode

steps.text: In Acro, settle inside the hover marker. Correct the tilt yourself and keep speed below 1 m/s.
steps.title: Hover with manual levelling

steps.text: Move to the nearby marker in Acro. Counter the tilt, brake and hold position.
steps.title: Move and brake in Acro

steps.text: Return to the start marker in Acro and settle before landing.
steps.title: Return and settle

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land at the start

steps.text: Raise throttle gently. Hold above 1 m for 2 seconds.
Follow the arrow through gate 1. Leave clearance from walls and overhead obstacles.
Follow the arrow through gate 2. Leave clearance from walls and overhead obstacles.
Follow the arrow through gate 3. Leave clearance from walls and overhead obstacles.
Slow down in an open area, lower throttle and hold a safe landing for two seconds.
Raise throttle gently. Hold above 1 m for 2 seconds.
Follow the arrow through gate 1. Leave clearance from walls and overhead obstacles.
Follow the arrow through gate 2. Leave clearance from walls and overhead obstacles.
Follow the arrow through gate 3. Leave clearance from walls and overhead obstacles.
Slow down in an open area, lower throttle and hold a safe landing for two seconds.
Take off gently and hold inside the marker. Keep speed below 1 m/s for two seconds.
steps.title: Take off and hold

steps.text: Follow the next-gate marker through original gate 1. Look ahead and leave room to turn.
steps.title: Pass original gate 1

steps.text: Follow the next-gate marker through original gate 2. Look ahead and leave room to turn.
steps.title: Pass original gate 2

steps.text: Follow the next-gate marker through original gate 3. Look ahead and leave room to turn.
steps.title: Pass original gate 3

steps.text: Choose a clear patch of terrain, level the drone and lower throttle gently until grounded for two seconds.
steps.title: Land gently

steps.text: Take off gently and hold inside the marker. Keep speed below 1 m/s for two seconds.
steps.title: Take off and hold

steps.text: Follow the next-gate marker through original gate 1. Look ahead and leave room to turn.
steps.title: Pass original gate 1

steps.text: Follow the next-gate marker through original gate 2. Look ahead and leave room to turn.
steps.title: Pass original gate 2

steps.text: Follow the next-gate marker through original gate 3. Look ahead and leave room to turn.
steps.title: Pass original gate 3

steps.text: Choose a clear patch of terrain, level the drone and lower throttle gently until grounded for two seconds.
steps.title: Land gently

steps.text: Take off gently and hold above one metre.
Pass through the next original gate.
Pass through the next original gate.
Pass through the next original gate.
Return to the floor and land.
